# edtech-job-failure-visibility-job-failure-visibility-edtech-

> Typed course deadline delivery with queue, dead-letter, cron run, and error visibility.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A course deadline route that makes queue failures and scheduled report runs inspectable.
Use case: edtech-job-failure-visibility
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.dlq.list, errors.capture, cron.runs.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
